thought.text: Clear error: only one booking-mode flag allowed. Retry with `isScheduleRelated` only.

reasoning_content: The error: "Only one booking mode flag may be true at a time (isScheduleRelated, isTimePeriodRelated)". We need to set only one of them. Let's use only `isScheduleRelated: true` (a schedule-based room). Retrying.

action.command:
cd /tmp && API=http://localhost:8081; PY='docker run --rm -i display-server:latest python'
TOKEN=$(curl -s -X POST $API/auth/signin -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"id":"admin","password":"admin"}' | $PY -c 'import sys,json;print(json.load(sys.stdin)["accessToken"])')
TENANT_ID=39605dab-2465-466f-b659-1b0bc138f426
BOOKABLE_ID=$(curl -s -X POST $API/api/$TENANT_ID/bookables -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"title":"Raum A","type":"room","isPublic":true,"isBookable":true,"isScheduleRelated":true,"amount":1,"maxAmountPerBooking":1,"minBookingDuration":15,"maxBookingDuration":480}' | $PY -c 'import sys,json;print(json.load(sys.stdin)["id"])')
echo "bookable_id=$BOOKABLE_ID"
NOW=$(date +%s%3N)
BEGIN=$(( (NOW/1000 + 3600) * 1000 ))
END=$(( (NOW/1000 + 3600 + 7200) * 1000 ))
echo "booking window (ms): begin=$BEGIN end=$END"
echo "booking resp:"
curl -s -X POST $API/api/$TENANT_ID/bookings -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d "{\"timeBegin\":$BEGIN,\"timeEnd\":$END,\"bookableItems\":[{\"bookableId\":\"$BOOKABLE_ID\",\"amount\":1}],\"name\":\"Max Mustermann\",\"mail\":\"max@example.com\",\"company\":\"Muster GmbH\",\"status\":\"confirmed\"}" | head -c 900
echo
{ echo "TENANT_ID=$TENANT_ID"; echo "BOOKABLE_ID=$BOOKABLE_ID"; } > /tmp/seed.env
